messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Computer-assisted nonlinear optimization with interval-arithmetic verification

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square is the unique (up to symmetry) arrangement where 12 points form a perturbed hexagonal lattice on the boundary and interior, with the 13th point at the center, and the maximum achievable minimum triangle area equals the algebraic number α ≈ 0.002114, the largest root of a degree-12 polynomial in Q[√3]. This configuration and the lower bound α can be verified rigorously by a branch-and-bound interval-arithmetic optimization that subdivides the configuration space and uses interval evaluations of all 286 triangle area determinants to prune any region where the minimum drops below α, thereby enclosing a unique feasible point within intervals of width < 10⁻¹⁰."}
